data.body: Implemented the 2026-10-27 operator decision as Gerrit change 3135 (cffe047b282). The Trace2 file lives under tmp_path, which pytest rotates after 3 sessions (no custom basetemp in this repo), so instead of copying it out the detector's failure message now carries the evidence: every maintenance-family process in the trace, split into rebar's top-level explicit step and git's nested auto-maintenance; each commit's exit t_abs (the commit duration asked for in the 10-27 22:15 comment); the tracker's gc.log; and count-objects -v. The verdict line says whether git chose not to run auto-maintenance or ran it outside the commit. Checked by forcing gc.auto=0 / maintenance.auto=false in the tracker: the detector failed and the message named 'git started no auto-maintenance under any process: it chose not to run it (top-level explicit steps: 1)', with commits at 0.008 s and gc.log absent. Two fast tests drive the diagnosis from synthetic traces. make verify: 19828 passed, 0 failed. Per the decision, the ticket stays open for the next natural failure, whose log will now name the mechanism.
